title: Legal Secretary
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Legal Secretary to join a well-established legal practice, offering a wide range of legal services to individuals and businesses alike.

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide secretarial and administrative support to solicitors, assisting with private client matters, legal documentation and day-to-day case administration.

This is a full-time office-based role offering a salary range of £23,000 - £29,000 and benefits.

You will be responsible for:
- Providing secretarial and administrative assistance to solicitors within the Private Client department.
- Preparing, formatting and amending legal documents, including wills, powers of attorney and trust deeds.
- Handling incoming correspondence, telephone calls and diary appointments.
- Communicating with clients and external parties professionally, maintaining confidentiality.
- Supporting file administration, billing and compliance procedures.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in a Legal secretarial role, or in a similar role .
- Typing speed of at least 50 words per minute, with strong document production skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

Desirable
- Private Client law experience.

Shift:
- Monday - Friday: 9:00am - 5:30pm

Candidates from the following backgrounds will be considered:
- Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant, Private Client Secretary, Private Client Assistant, Legal Administrator, Legal clerk, Private Client Assistant, Wills and Probate Assistant or in a similar role.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a proactive and professional Legal Secretary to advance their career within a respected firm.

Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, Additional Resources will be acting in your best interest and may contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our Privacy Policy on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please contact us.

Additional Resources Ltd is an Employment Business and an Employment Agency as defined within The Conduct of Employment Agencies & Employment Businesses Regulations 2003.

title: Litigation Legal Administrator
description:
We are working with a specialist legal practice based close to Hertford who are looking to recruit a Property Litigation Legal Administrator to join their growing team. This is an opportunity for someone with legal experience to develop their career within property litigation, supporting solicitors with a high volume of residential and commercial claims.

The role would suit someone who enjoys managing a busy workload, communicating with clients and taking ownership of their cases. Property litigation experience would be beneficial, although candidates from other areas of law who have a genuine interest in moving into property litigation will also be considered.

Typical Duties:
- Manage a high volume of residential and commercial claims relating to service charges, ground rent, possession and breaches of lease.
- Prepare and process claim forms, court applications, consent orders and supporting documentation.
- Support solicitors with possession claims, forfeiture proceedings and enforcement action.
- Manage case progression, maintain accurate records and ensure court deadlines and daily targets are met.
- Communicate with clients and other stakeholders by telephone and email, including managing calls from the enquiry line and resolving queries.

Candidate Requirements:
- At least one year of experience working within a legal environment.
- Property litigation experience would be preferred, although candidates from other legal backgrounds will be considered.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within property litigation.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of work accurately.
- Confident communication skills and a willingness to handle regular telephone enquiries.

This is an office-based close to Hertford, working within a large, friendly team with plenty to learn. The role offers the opportunity to develop your legal knowledge, take ownership of your own cases and gain experience supporting solicitors across possession and enforcement matters.

If you are looking to develop your legal career and are interested in property litigation, we would be keen to hear from you.

Please apply via the advert or contact Calum at Eclectic Recruitment for more information.

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email to discuss other potential opportunities.

title: Paralegal
company: Personnel Link Employment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Paralegal

Location: Hertford
Salary: Up to 30,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

We are recruiting a Paralegal to join an established legal team in Hertford. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with at least 12 months' experience working within a legal environment who is looking to develop their career within property litigation.

Working alongside experienced solicitors, you will assist with a varied caseload involving property disputes, service charge and ground rent arrears, possession proceedings and landlord and tenant matters.

What You'll Do
- Assist solicitors with managing and progressing property litigation cases.
- Prepare legal documents, court forms, correspondence and case bundles.
- Support service charge and ground rent recovery, possession and enforcement proceedings.
- Assist with landlord and tenant matters, lease breaches and property disputes.
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, courts and other third parties.
- Maintain accurate case records and ensure deadlines and procedures are met.

What We're Looking For
- At least 12 months' experience working in a legal role, ideally within a law firm or legal department.
- Previous experience as a Paralegal, Legal Assistant, Litigation Assistant or Legal Administrator.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage a busy workload and work to deadlines.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within property litigation.

Who Might Suit This Role

This opportunity would suit an existing Paralegal, Legal Assistant or Litigation Assistant looking to take the next step in their legal career. Candidates with experience in property law, conveyancing, civil litigation, debt recovery or landlord and tenant matters would be particularly desirable.

Why Join
- Salary up to 30,000 depending on experience.
- Opportunity to develop specialist property litigation experience.
- Work alongside an experienced legal team.
- Long-term career development within an established legal practice.
